text:
Olivia Grant: FYI we saw increased host log ingestion and downstream pipeline backpressure starting ~14:03 UTC after a rollout. Symptoms: elevated request latency for Dedicated control-plane calls and ~0.4% 429s for small-batch embedding writes. Opening thread for mitigation + comms.

Ravi Menon: Noted. Any obvious culprit from the rollout?

Olivia Grant: Preliminary: a feature-flag flip (trace-verbose=on) was accidentally included in a global config push; it turned on high-frequency trace emission from the request path for dedicated control-plane APIs. That caused logshipper spikes and temporarily filled the local log buffer -> RB backpressure.

ops-bot: rollback-config trace-verbose -> off triggered by @Ravi Menon at 14:07 UTC. Canary verification completed.

Theo Park: Mitigations applied: 1) rolled flag off globally, 2) increased logshipper backoff and auto-throttle, 3) drained ingestion queue and relaunched 2 logshard pods in eu/dedicated clusters.

Olivia Grant: Impact: primarily Dedicated control-plane; some customers experienced transient 429s on small embedding writes and slightly elevated scheduling latency. No inference results lost. Estimated impact window: 14:0314:10 UTC.

CS-bot: Draft customer bulletin created and posted to #support-digest. Status page entry: https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2909999999

Ravi Menon: Quick SRE commands to inspect ingestion backpressure:

```bash
# check logshipper queue depths and recent emit rates
rdwctl logs shipper metrics --cluster dedicated-eu --last 15m --json | jq .emit_rate,.queue_depth
# toggle flag if needed
rdwctl feature toggle trace-verbose --env production --set false
```

Theo Park: Metrics update: p95 control-plane latency returned to baseline by 14:12 UTC. 429 rate normalized by 14:15 UTC after backoff + pod relaunch. Monitoring shows no residual queue growth.

Olivia Grant: Post-incident actions: 1) add CI gate preventing global toggles of trace-verbose without a targeted canary, 2) add auto-throttle to logshipper that kicks in if emit_rate > 50k/min, 3) tabletop with release engineering to tighten rollout checklist.

Ravi Menon: I'll open PRs for the CI gate and logshipper throttle. Tagging @oncall for visibility.

status-bot: incident-severity: SEV3 (transient customer-impacting latency/errors). Monitoring threshold for similar events set to 2x baseline emit_rate for 5m.

CS-bot: CS to notify affected customers and offer follow-up. Olivia to provide final timeline + RCA by EOD.

Olivia Grant: Thanks team. Keeping thread pinned until RCA + bulletin are complete. :pin:
